تشتملين (form VIII)
# تَشْتَمِلِينَ (taštamilīna) /taʃ.ta.mi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# تُشْتَمَلِينَ (tuštamalīna) /tuʃ.ta.ma.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
